liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments were stable at {{cash_like@FY2025}}, a change of {{cash_like.change@FY2025}}, and cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2025}}.
Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, so the near-term maturities are covered by cash on hand without new funding.

In FY2024 free cash flow after lease payments was {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, or {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, showing that lease payments absorbed the cash that free cash flow left out.

Customer prepayments rose, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}, and advance ticket cover increased by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, the lowest of the peer group.
